resources.string: Show render paths, texture re-upload and save timings on the canvas (diagnostics; keep off)
Experiment A: downscale the source texture; deformation geometry is unchanged while texture bandwidth and memory drop (applies to the next gesture)
latest-state-wins: max substeps advanced per frame; off means per-point processing (applies to the next gesture)
Which path draws the warp preview: engine CPU / AGSL overlay / GLES overlay (applies to the next gesture; the HUD "preview" field shows the one actually in use)

Where the warp field comes from: a persistent float field (full resolution, no stepping or window seams) or the Krita grid (applies to the next gesture; the decision is frozen at gesture start; the HUD "field" cell shows which one is in use)
